fixed_defect.fix: ToolError carries `code`; assert_chart_in_scope raises it with chart_out_of_scope; 16 catch sites forward it; normalise() attaches the recovery hint for a body that already knows its code
fixed_defect.replay_diff: tool_calls[0].refused: query_failed -> chart_out_of_scope (one field, nothing else)
fixed_defect.was: assert_chart_in_scope refused correctly but result.classify() mapped its message to query_failed, because _CODE_HINTS matched 'not in scope' while the guard emits 'is not part of this dashboard'
fixed_defect.why_it_mattered: query_failed is documented retryable, so a model refused a chart it may never read was told to try again and never saw the chart_out_of_scope recovery hint
